page.content:
Arcade original that staged Shang Tsung's island tournament.

How Mortal Kombat (1992) connects

  • Topic: Mortal Kombat — Mortal Kombat (1992) is the arcade game that began the saga.
  • Character: Liu Kang — Mortal Kombat (1992) made Liu Kang the Shaolin who wins the island tournament.
  • Concept: Fatalities — Mortal Kombat (1992) made fatalities the series' signature finish.
  • Character: Scorpion — Mortal Kombat (1992) introduced Scorpion's spear and hellfire fatality.
  • Character: Sub-Zero — Mortal Kombat (1992) introduced Sub-Zero as the Lin Kuei ice ninja.

What is Mortal Kombat (1992)?

Mortal Kombat (1992) is the Midway arcade game that introduced Liu Kang, Sonya, Johnny Cage, Scorpion, Sub-Zero, and Goro, and made fatalities a cultural fight.

Key threads lead to Mortal Kombat, Liu Kang, Fatalities, Scorpion and Sub-Zero.
